claims: Santa Rosa, California, is the Sonoma County seat.
Santa Rosa is the home of Peanuts creator Charles Schulz.
Santa Rosa is located roughly 55 miles north of San Francisco.
Homes in Santa Rosa often cost $700k–$2M+.
The Fountaingrove neighborhood in Santa Rosa was rebuilt after 2017 fires.
Santa Rosa Junior College is in Santa Rosa.
Santa Rosa is served by Charles M. Schulz-Sonoma County Airport (STS).
Santa Rosa has experienced significant, well-documented wildfire impacts.
Major community rebuilding efforts have occurred in the Coffee Park and Fountaingrove areas.
Santa Rosa has industries in healthcare, tourism, and education.
Russian River Brewing Company is a brewery in Santa Rosa.
Santa Rosa has a new Downtown Art Walk.
A separate, unrelated Santa Rosa County exists in Florida.
